{{Quote|This can't be in the Drackmar system. It's only got one sun.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], about [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]|<ref name="TCoPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>}}
The '''Drackmar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] with multiple [[Star/Legends|suns]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> located in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the world [[Drackmar]], homeworld of the [[Drackmarian]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Around [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Praxeum ship/Legends|training vessel]] ''[[Chu'unthor]]'' was damaged during a battle in the Drackmar system, eventually crashing on the nearby [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

Sometimes prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Drackmarians were defeated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="TTaBS">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> and the Drackmar system was integrated in the [[Quelii Oversector]]. The system was later part of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s [[Zsinj's Empire|empire]] and, after the death of Zsinj, was [[Post–Zsinj campaigns|annexed]] by loyal Imperial forces. The Drackmar system was conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in the early stages of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TEA" />
